findings.title: Timed-out batches are reported as acknowledged and never retried
findings.trigger: send_batch raises BrokerTimeout for any batch.
findings.impact: _publish_topic records a batch's ids before sending it, so when send_batch times out the batch is already in the returned list and relay_once marks it published. Those events leave the outbox without reaching the broker, breaking the at-least-once promise in outbox.py; the ids belong after a successful send.
